estimate.note: Range widened post-Mar-2026 papers: low end firm (3.5y matches the Google/Cloudflare/EF 2029 migration target), high end stretched to align with Drake's public 50%-by-2032 (6y) odds. Midpoint moved from 3.0 to 4.0 — slightly later than prior because resource-estimate breakthroughs do not move hardware forward, but uncertainty has grown in both directions.

factoring.note: 21-bit RSA via Shor unchanged; 15-bit ECDLP demonstrated Apr 2026. Algorithmic side has moved sharply: Google paper Mar 31 2026 cuts ECDLP-secp256k1 resource estimate ~10x; Oratomic Mar 31 2026 claims 10K physical qubits suffice; Schrottenloher rediscovery + ecdsa.fail crowdsourced -8.4% (Jun 2026).

logical_qubits.note: Target switched from RSA-2048 (4000 LQ) to ECDLP-secp256k1 (1,200-1,450 LQ per Google Mar 31 2026) since that is now the more proximate cryptographic break. QuEra Mar 2026: 96 LQ; Quantinuum Helios Nov 2025: 48 error-corrected. Log-scale progress.

roadmap_consensus.note: DOE 2028, IBM Starling 2029, Google 2029, Microsoft/Atom 2027, Quantinuum 2030, PsiQuantum 2029. Google/Cloudflare/EF have converged on 2029 as the PQC migration target.

error_correction.note: Multi-vendor below-threshold + Quantinuum Helios delivers 10-100x logical-vs-physical improvement

investment.note: 2025 total ~$17.5B (incl $4.9B private VC, more than doubled YoY)

divincenzo.note: Helios upgrades C1 from demonstrated to scalable

external_estimates.source: Justin Drake (Ethereum Foundation, Google paper co-author)
external_estimates.note: Most credible insider estimate. Drake references non-public information and calls the US gov 2035 timeline 'a joke'. Aligns with Google/EF/Cloudflare 2029 PQC migration target as the 'safe' deadline.
Independent academic commentary on the Google paper's implications
Federal PQC migration deadline. Widely considered conservative; expected to be pulled forward.

caveat: This estimate reflects current trajectory. Quantum progress is nonlinear -- breakthroughs can compress timelines rapidly. Note: Mar 2026 Google + Oratomic papers reduce resource requirements ~10x and ~5 orders of magnitude (vs 2017) respectively, but do NOT advance hardware — actual logical qubit counts still ~13x below the new ECDLP target.
